_readme: The weekly defaults watch (scripts/defaults-watch.mjs) reads each rule's page, finds `anchor`, runs `pattern` (a JS regex on the normalized page text; capture group 1 is the value) and compares the value with the data. No rule stores the value it expects: a "field" rule compares with the value at `maps_to` (and writes it there, plus every `also` path, through one bot pull request when the page changes); a "flag" rule only lists a change for review, comparing with `maps_to`, a claim's quote or sentence (`baseline.claim`), or a `baseline.sentinel` for a value the data does not hold. `{name|short|slug|ref|id:<tool>.<slot>}` in anchor, pattern or sentence is filled from the data at run time. Schema: scripts/validate-data.mjs validateWatchList.
